title: 872. Decoded String at Index

examples.explanation: The tape grows to "leet", then "leetleet", then "leetleetcode", then three copies of that. The 10th character is "o".
The tape grows to "ha", then "haha", then "hahahaha". The 5th character is "h".
The tape starts with "a" and is repeated a huge number of times, so the first character is "a".
